title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model predicts the probability that a student prefers Kendrick $$(y=1)$$ over Drake $$(y=0)$$. The model uses the parameter vector $$\theta=(-2, 2, 1)$$.

title: Formulating the Logistic Regression Equation
text: The logistic regression equation is given by: $$\ln\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\right)=\theta_0+\theta_1 X_1+\theta_2 X_2$$, where $$p$$ is the probability that $$y=1$$.

title: Setting the Probability Threshold
text: To find the decision boundary, set the probability $$p$$ to $$0.5$$. This means $$\ln\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\right)=0$$.

title: Solving for the Decision Boundary
text: Substitute the parameter values and set $$\ln\left(\frac{p}{1-p}\right)=0$$ to find the decision boundary equation.
